summary.core_axiom: Reality is an equation that can be grown, copied, doubled, and proven by scale.
summary.motion_model: question -> variable -> proof -> scale break -> materialized theorem
summary.tier_note: Current-school-core, original college-core, mechanic-core, commander-structural-anchor, and Simic structural anchors are intentionally separated to avoid flattening Quandrix into generic Simic ramp/counters.
